dialogue.Ranger1Intro:
We're Pokémon Rangers! When Trainers get stranded in the wild, we're the ones who find them!

Let's see how well you handle a rescue team!
dialogue.Ranger1After: Arcanine can track a missing Trainer by scent, even through rough terrain. It's one of our most dependable rescue Pokémon!
dialogue.Ranger2Intro:
Our Flying Pokémon patrol the skies, looking for Trainers who need help.

Think you can handle an aerial rescue team?
dialogue.Ranger2After:
Fearow covers enormous distances during the day. Noctowl takes over at night.

Someone's always watching out for Trainers!
dialogue.Ranger3Intro:
Rivers, lakes, oceans... Trainers can get into trouble anywhere!

Our Pokémon train to handle even the toughest rescues!
dialogue.Ranger3After:
Golduck is an incredible swimmer. It can reach stranded Trainers before anyone else.

Manectric helps us search along the shoreline!
dialogue.Ranger4Intro:
Rangers have been protecting Trainers for generations!

We've earned our reputation by going where others can't. Show me what you've got!
dialogue.Ranger4After:
Caves, mountains, storms... No matter where a Trainer falls, we do our best to bring them home.

That's what being a Ranger means!
dialogue.ParkLore:
Welcome to the Pokémon Ranger Headquarters!

I'm Ranger Park. I've spent many years helping Trainers across Kanto.

You know, when a Trainer blacks out in the wild, they don't just wake up at a Pokémon Center by magic!

That's our job! We find them, get them to safety, and make sure their Pokémon receive treatment.

We do charge a rescue fee, but we work on a sliding scale. Usually, it's about half the money a Trainer has on hand.

Nobody gets left behind just because they're short on cash!
dialogue.ParkChallenge:
Now, I've heard some impressive things about your journey.

You've got the makings of a fine Ranger yourself!

How about a battle? Show me what you've learned!
dialogue.ParkLocked: You've got potential, but I'd like you to train with my four Rangers first. Come back after you've defeated them all!
dialogue.ParkDefeat: Outstanding! You've got the courage and judgment of a true Ranger!
dialogue.ParkBeforeGift:
That was an impressive battle!

You've got a real talent for working with Pokémon.

I think you'd make a fine Ranger someday!

Take a look behind me. Those three Poké Balls contain Pokémon we've trained for rescue work.

I'd like you to take one along on your journey. Consider it a gift from all of us!
dialogue.ParkAfterGift:
Excellent choice! That Pokémon has helped us through countless rescue exercises.

Take good care of it, and it'll take good care of you!

Remember, a Ranger's greatest strength isn't power. It's knowing when someone needs help!
dialogue.ParkNo: No pressure! A good Ranger knows when they're ready.
dialogue.ParkYes: Excellent! Let's see how you handle a real rescue team!

technical_prompts.NeedTwo: Please bring two Pokémon ready to battle.
technical_prompts.GiftFull: Your party is full. Use the PC to make room, then come back.
technical_prompts.GiftLocked: These Pokémon are reserved until you defeat Ranger Park.
technical_prompts.GiftTaken: You have already received your Pokémon.
